prior_review.result: unsigned review contract pass only. Not ready and not operational acceptance. That package stays immutable.

refresh.order: line 73 LIVE -> CODEMERGE || exit 1, then line 74 CODEMERGE -> DASH/BASE || exit 1
refresh.step1_failure: exits before step 2, so a failed live copy does not publish stale codemerge onto dash
refresh.successful_refresh: copies the live pair onto codemerge, then that tree onto dash. A live+dash pair therefore stays after the next successful refresh.
refresh.codemerge: receives the payload by this refresh. It is not a write root and this controller does not copy there.
refresh.automatic_dash_restart: The digest is taken from codemerge and may rewrite dash state/.thf_code_md5. tfo-dash-thf-reload.path can restart tfo-dash-thf. This controller does not call systemctl. There is no equivalent msgdesk path.
refresh.loaded_sha: not proven. The sampler status version is not a file hash.

race.import_order: payload sampler imports lesson_trace and then thf_shadow_bench at module level
race.commit: stage both files, then os.replace sampler and os.replace bench with no call between them
race.timer: non-drill apply refuses when the next tfo-thf-shadow.timer elapse is under 180 seconds or cannot be read. The timer is not stopped.
race.probe: systemctl show plus a /proc cmdline scan, before the lock, after the lock, and before and after each root commit
race.residual_authority: A process that appears after the last probe and opens the old sampler before the bench replace can still import a mixed pair. Closing that residual needs a drop-in so tfo-thf-shadow.service flocks tools/.code_release.lock around the existing ExecStart. This package does not install that drop-in and does not stop the timer, the engine, or a provider.
